title: Government Announces 400 Paid Internships for 2026/27 and Ministry of Water 65 Positions Open, How to Apply Before Deadline
text:
YETU

Written by

in

They need 400 people and the deadline is Sunday 7th Sept 2026 so apply now. Runs for for 12 months. They need recent graduates from year 2024 who scored second class upper and above. The applicants will have ICT, Computer Science,software Eng, Information systems, electrical, Telecoms

If you set to graduate this year 2026 apply with a school letter showing you in the fourth year set to graduate.

only apply in their official portal; recruitment.digitalent.go.ke

2. Ministry of Water, Sanitation and Irrigation -World Bank Project

They need 65 interns. Deadline is 18th september 2026. It lasts for 12 months has paid stipends and starts in January 2027.

People applying should be aged btween 25-35. Graduated within the last two years. courses entail Geology, hydrogeology, Environmental science, Water/civil  Eng,sociology,gender, GIS, Remote sensing, ICT, Data science, chemistry etc.

To apply send to hoa@rcgw.go.ke email subject should be ‘APPLICATION FOR THE HoAGW4RP INTERNSHIP 2027’
